summary: First full test of Live Adda MVP. Backend: 28/28 pytest tests pass covering auth (register/login/logout/me), gatekeeping (upload/live-slot without plan → 403 with EXACT message '⚠️ Please purchase a slot/plan first to proceed.'), videos CRUD + rename + storage decrement, live-slot start/stop/settings, Stripe checkout session creation + status, billings current-plan + transactions, support ticket, dashboard stats. Frontend: landing page renders hero+features+pricing (3 plans each showing 2GB), protected route /dashboard correctly redirects to /login when logged out, fresh-user registration lands on dashboard with 'No Active Plan' warning, VideoManager Upload button shows the no-plan dialog with the EXACT gatekeeping message, Billings shows 3 plans each with 2GB, admin login (admin@liveadda.com/admin123) reaches dashboard with 365 days plan validity. Stripe test key sk_test_emergent successfully created a real checkout session (session_id + checkout_url returned).

minor.issue: Cookie is deleted without matching attributes (path='/'), works in practice but not strictly RFC-compliant; also delete_cookie won't work cross-site because it doesn't set secure/samesite='none'. Fine for current same-origin preview URL.

Cookies set with secure=False and samesite='lax'. Works because the preview URL is proxied same-origin. For direct cross-site fetches from another host this would fail—main agent should be aware if production deploy differs.
Entire file is read into memory (await file.read()) before size check → true 2GB upload would consume 2GB of RAM. Recommend streaming/chunked writes and incremental size check.

Webhook does not verify Stripe-Signature nor actually update plan on paid event; plan is only updated when frontend polls /checkout-status. If browser closes between Stripe redirect and polling completion the plan may never activate.
Does not call check_active_plan; a user whose plan has expired can still hit stop (harmless). Not a blocker.

integration_issues.issue: LiveSlot.jsx does NOT surface the exact backend pop-up message. It shows a custom passive card 'No Active Plan / Purchase a plan to start streaming' instead of the specified pop-up '⚠️ Please purchase a slot/plan first to proceed.' Spec explicitly says accessing stream without active plan should 'trigger pop-up' with that exact text. Backend correctly returns 403 with the exact detail, but the LiveSlot page swallows it into a card.

Not verified end-to-end because uploading a large file over the preview URL is impractical in an automated run. Upload progress bar (data-testid='upload-progress-percent') and 'Ready for the stream!' toast are wired in code; backend returns the message; not blocking.

action_items: (Optional) Show the exact gatekeeping pop-up ('⚠️ Please purchase a slot/plan first to proceed.') on the LiveSlot page as a Dialog too, mirroring VideoManager behavior, to fully match business rule #3.
(Optional) Stream file uploads instead of loading whole file into memory to safely handle up to 2GB.
(Optional) Implement real Stripe webhook signature verification + activate plan on webhook (defense in depth vs. relying only on polling).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 789 lines in a single file — nearing the 700-line threshold. Consider splitting into routers (auth, videos, live_slot, payments, billings, support, dashboard).
Upload endpoint reads full file into memory before writing to disk (see server.py:330). Add chunked streaming and incremental storage check.

Cookies use secure=False / samesite='lax'. If the app is ever served from a different origin than the API, cross-site cookies will not be sent. Consider secure=True + samesite='none' behind HTTPS for production.

check_active_plan is not applied to /live-slot/stop, /videos (list), /videos/{id}/rename, /videos/{id} (delete). The spec says upload+stream are gated; current impl matches spec, but consider whether rename/delete should also require an active plan.
test_credentials.md is overwritten on every backend startup — safe here but wipes any additions.
Stripe webhook endpoint accepts without signature verification (server.py:627-634) — must be hardened before production.
test_credentials: Admin: admin@liveadda.com / admin123 (monthly plan, 365 days). Fresh test users created dynamically in tests (prefix TEST_ / testuser_).
seed_data_creation: Admin user seeded on backend startup (server.py:727-755). Test suite creates ephemeral TEST_ prefixed users but does not clean them up — recommend a cleanup task if this DB is reused heavily.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live in /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py and are pytest-based with class-scoped fixtures using requests.Session. Admin auto-seeded with monthly plan. To grant a plan to a user for gatekeeping tests: db.users.updateOne({email}, {$set:{plan:'daily', plan_expires_at: new Date(Date.now()+86400000)}}). Public preview URL is https://live-control-panel.preview.emergentagent.com (via frontend/.env). CORS uses allow_origin_regex='.*' with credentials — works via same-origin proxy. Exact gatekeeping message string (with warning emoji + trailing period) must match precisely: '⚠️ Please purchase a slot/plan first to proceed.'
rca of the issue: No critical bugs. Only observation is LiveSlot page presents gatekeeping as a passive card rather than a pop-up dialog. Not a functional bug — backend correctly enforces gating and returns exact error string — but a UX deviation from the stated rule #3.
